objective: Earlier certified device-normal reference reduces later normal OOD false alarms while retaining SAME-device attack recall.

data.labels: normal-source provenance; LOIC verified source/victim/local service and current data/SYN/request; Hydra current authorized DESCRIBE; all other attack-capture traffic unassigned
data.sample_semantics: Systematic equal-rank sample of every eligible capture-local canonical session, before scores; no claim of full-packet rate or independent samples.
data.roles: 6 LEARN only optimizer rows, 2 DEV only fixed endpoint diagnostics/gate, 3 DEVICE_HOLDOUT only one conditional confirmation; registration references never optimizer targets.
data.calibration: No new threshold calibration. DEV is a decision/gate set, not fitted threshold data.
data.reference_policy: Earliest three normal captures, latest valid endpoint per owner/canonical dependency component, hash-order up to64. Observation ended before query; live transport termination is NOT asserted.
data.ongoing_connection_policy: Same canonical reference/query component retained as causal continued-connection stratum; report separately from new components. No independence claim.
data.context: Use ScopedPrefixes shared guard before every reference/query append; source-local owner/capture/key; permanent poison on regression; no future/backfilled rows; full-row deep copy at target.
data.partial_failure: No silent feature-row deletion. Any in-scope forward, identity, numeric or source mismatch stops the chain. Metadata-stage exclusions remain explicit.

model.numeric_path: E3 float32; standardize float64 with original mean/scale; append missing0; full row float32; P2 float32
model.e3_runtime: Existing e3_embed_v1 build_e3_runtime + embed_flows semantics; model eval, local_files_only, config.pretraining=False, compile=False, tokenizer.pretraining=True, raw_labels=False; no changes to old fixed-size CLI contracts

legacy.decision: float32 sigmoid then float64 comparison >= unchanged probability threshold
legacy.no_reference: Exact original R path. Original ID and old unrelated OOD/attacks do not receive this device-specific adaptation.

ID_anchor.use: Historical unchanged fallback row, explicitly reused; no new independent ID experiment or reopened arrays. Verify routing with synthetic no-reference equality.

C.pool: masked mean and max across actual refs; no padded entries in either reduction

arms.shared: b_R plus residual; last linear weight/bias zero; hidden PyTorch Linear default initialization; no dropout in new heads; R eval, all R/E3 tensors frozen; z original float64 standardization then float32; metadata excluded

optimization.loss: BCEWithLogits; device and class equal, then activity/mode, capture, canonical session and selected row equal; exact per-row rational denominators in manifests
optimization.minibatch_loss: N/batch_actual_size * sum(weight_i * BCE_i); no within-batch weight renormalization
optimization.ordering: Independent local CPU randperm generator seeded with run seed; same permutations across Q/M/C; each epoch each UID once, no oversampling
optimization.initialization: torch.manual_seed(seed) before constructing each new head; deterministic CPU ops; R state never trained
optimization.selection: Fixed final epoch only; all three seeds reported; main score average of final-seed logits, not best seed

evaluation.main: Matched UID/label/reference cost/operating point R/Q/M/C; report integer errors and sampled denominators plus exact hierarchical rates
mandatory: Original ID FPR clearly marked reused unchanged fallback
LEARN normal/attack fit diagnostics clearly in-sample
DEV normal OOD FPR and per-device/mode attack TPR
Conditional DEVICE_HOLDOUT normal FPR and attack TPR
Reference-covered vs novel annotated activity; Active is unknown activity, never asserted novel
R-correct new misses and R-missed new detections by device/attack/capture
Every missing capability cell, excluded label mode and unsupported protocol
Philips local inbound TCP80 normal control only; no outbound remote80 substitution
evaluation.uncertainty: Device/capture/attack-run clusters; only2DEV and3holdout devices. Descriptive paired group differences; no packet-binomial CI or independent1% risk certification.
evaluation.low_fpr: Descriptive only; no fitted threshold, selected operating point or holdout-driven tuning

interventions.note: Offline diagnostic only; wrong-owner routing is prohibited in deployment. Equal reference count AND protocol multiset; compare these explicit correct/wrong UID lists, never full correct versus fewer wrong references.

Offline diagnostic only; wrong-owner routing is prohibited in deployment. Equal reference count AND protocol multiset; compare these explicit correct/wrong UID lists, never full correct versus fewer wrong references.

evaluation.budget16: Same query, hash-first min(16,actual) true references; no retraining; report actual budget; no best intervention promotion
evaluation.heldout_gate: After all9 endpoints sealed: open once if M or C reduces macro DEV normal FPR, neither DEV device normal FPR increases, and attack hierarchical TPR is >=R-0.01 in EACH DEV device and available attack mode. Missing essential cell or any engineering failure closes gate. Q alone passing does not establish reference utility.
evaluation.mechanism_claim: C needs joint benefit over R AND lower DEV normal macro FPR than M with no >1pp per-device/mode attack loss versus M; equal-count correct/wrong-reference intervention must provide directional evidence on >=1DEV device. Otherwise no C-specific innovation claim; M may be preferable.
evaluation.gate_status: Development decision only. Point estimates do not certify noninferiority. If opened, report ALL R/Q/M/C and ALL seeds/interventions on frozen holdout once; no subsequent tuning from holdout.

runtime.feature_reuse: One identity-verified raw E3 feature cache shared across arms/seeds. Prepare LEARN/DEV first; heldout queries only after gate, within future explicit authorization.
runtime.throughput: No separate resource trial. Persist progress/observed rate during authorized real preparation; no promised finish time from unmeasured throughput.
runtime.stop: Identity/label/causality/shape/nonfinite/worker error, resource bound or stopped process: stop, retain receipts, no automatic retry, source changes or silent sample pruning.

implementation_acceptance_required: Exact shared guard on ALL feature appends and deep-copy at targets
Real tokenizer/collator with synthetic stand-in model, no checkpoint access in tests
R equality at zero residual; no-reference exact fallback
Padding masked in C and M, population std and variable reference budgets
Equal weighted UID exposure across arms/seeds
HOLDOUT inaccessible to optimizer/normalization/calibration and scoring before gate
claim_exclusions: simultaneous live-network interference proved by separately captured files
